data.description: You can kill with a single stroke.
data.name: Deadly Stroke (Mythic)

raw_tokens.value: You can kill with a single stroke.

When making a Deadly Stroke attack, you can expend one use of mythic power to instantly kill a non-mythic living creature. A Fortitude save (DC %1) negates this effect, though the attack still deals double damage and Con bleed as Deadly Stroke. Constructs, oozes, and creatures immune to critical hits or precision-based damage can't be killed with this feat.|10+BAB+MythicLevel
